people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor, because it was done for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.
